summary: PR-1507 adds one store method that copies payments with a given status into an archive table and deletes them from the live table. All SQL is fixed and parameterized, and no NPI columns are involved. Ticket, independent code review, security review and CI on the head commit are all in order, and no protected paths or ledger-covered code are touched. Two weaknesses do not block acceptance: the description claims unit tests were updated though none changed, and deleting rows could let payment IDs be reused under the MAX(id)+1 scheme. Every applicable obligation is shown, so the change is accepted.
